title: Mild Chicken Paprikash with Sweet Pepper Gravy
description: Fully caramelized onion, sweet paprika and red pepper give this Hungarian-style chicken its rust-red sour cream gravy.
equipment: Immersion blender and deep heatproof jug

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.note: Use plain, unenhanced poultry. Remove visible fat before weighing.

ingredients.name: yellow onion
ingredients.note: Slice paper-thin and caramelize completely in the first step.

ingredients.name: peeled roasted red bell pepper
ingredients.note: Plain and unsalted, with all skin and seeds removed.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Use plain chicken-and-water broth without a vegetable blend or added seasoning.

steps.title: Caramelize the onion
steps.text: Melt {butter} in the HexClad over medium-low. Add {onion} and cook for 18–25 minutes, stirring often, until fully caramelized, soft and golden brown. Loosen any browned spots with a spoonful of {broth}.

steps.title: Bloom the paprika
steps.text: Lift the skillet off heat and stir {paprika} into the softened onion for 10 seconds, just until fragrant.

steps.title: Build the pepper broth
steps.text: Add {pepper} and the remaining broth. Return the skillet to medium-low and bring to a gentle simmer.

steps.title: Braise the thighs
steps.text: Unfold {chicken} into the pepper broth and cover. Keep at a gentle simmer for 12–22 minutes, turning halfway, until every thigh reaches 175°F. Hold the chicken covered with a spoonful of the broth.

steps.title: Blend the braise
steps.text: Blend the peppers, onions and cooking liquid in a deep jug until smooth. Pass the mixture through a fine sieve into the skillet and bring it to a boil.

steps.title: Bind the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and let it bubble gently for 1 minute, stirring until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Temper the sour cream
steps.text: Whisk warm gravy into {cream} in a cup. Return this mixture to the skillet off heat and whisk until the color is even.

steps.title: Sauce and serve
steps.text: Slice the thighs across the grain and nestle them into the paprika gravy. Serve the meat and all the gravy in shallow bowls.

notes: Sauce yield: About 1 1/2 cups for two. Make ahead: Caramelize the onion a day ahead and refrigerate it in a sealed container. Refrigerate shallow portions within 2 hours. Use refrigerated leftovers within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. For the smoothest gravy, freeze the chicken and blended base before adding sour cream, up to 2 months. Add the sour cream after thawing and reheating. Fridge reheat: Warm the paprika chicken and gravy covered in the HexClad over medium-low with a splash of water. Stir or turn occasionally and check from 6 minutes, until the center reaches 165°F. Freezer reheat: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator, then follow the fridge reheating directions. Option A uses the full sweet paprika and sour cream. For gentler Option B, halve the paprika and replace the sour cream with skim milk. Plain unsweetened oat cream also works for a dairy-free finish. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 273 kcal, 30.4 g protein, 10.4 g total carbohydrate, 11.8 g fat, 1.7 g fiber, 171 mg sodium. Includes all the chicken and sauce in the listed recipe. Sodium varies with the broth. Fiber is estimated before straining.
